after.rosterkit/contacts.py:
# owner: platform
from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student


# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    roster = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    if not roster:
        raise ValueError("no students for the contact sheet")
    missing = [item.display_name for item in roster if not item.email]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"no email for {missing[0]}")
    return [f"{item.display_name:<20} {item.section:<8} {item.email}" for item in roster]
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_sorted_by_name_in_columns(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            Student("2", "Young", "Zed", "B", "zed@example.invalid"),
            Student("1", "Adams", "Amy", "A", "amy@example.invalid")
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], "Adams, Amy           A        amy@example.invalid")
        self.assertTrue(rows[1].startswith("Young, Zed"))

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Adams, Amy"):
            contact_rows([Student("1", "Adams", "Amy", "A")])

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_rows([])
